name: EasyVista Service Manager
description: Manage EasyVista Service Manager incidents, requests, documents and workflow actions.

base_url.description: HTTPS protocol and host of the EasyVista server, without a path
base_url.title: Base Url

tenant_id.description: Non-empty EasyVista account number, including any leading zeros
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

use_token.title: Use Token
use_token.description: Use access token (Bearer) authentication, recommended; false: Basic authentication

username.title: Username
username.description: REST API user login; required when use_token is false

password.title: Password
password.description: REST API user password; required when use_token is false

token.title: Token
token.description: EasyVista access token; required when use_token is true
